stories.title: Families urged to check eligibility for School Essentials Grant ahead of September term
stories.summary: With the September term fast approaching, families across Wales are being urged to find out if they are eligible for support from the School Essentials Grant. stories.title: Motorcycle recorded at 127mph on A494 in Mold, North Wales Police say
stories.summary: A motorcycle was recorded travelling at 127mph on the A494 in Mold during police patrols at the weekend. stories.title: Deeside packaging manufacturer recruiting five apprentices
stories.summary: Five apprenticeships have opened at MM Packaging on Deeside Industrial Park, with places in engineering, finance, operations and estimating. The company makes cartonboard packaging for brands in confectionery, drinks, pet food, cereal and frozen food from its site on Parkway.
